reuse.why: Uses the existing extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag and the existing getCategoryAverage and setNMonthAvg, and the new last-month action is built on the shared selection and sign helpers. hasSavedTemplates parses goal_def on its own rather than going through any goal-template helper.

duplication.why: Which categories get filled is decided once (shouldFillCategory) and the sign flip once (averageToBudgetAmount). The group-notes join is written in two SQL queries (getBudgetData and getAllCategoriesWithGroupHidden), and setZero filters inline while the average actions call getCategoriesForAverage.

placement.why: The selection rule, its predicates and the amount conversion live in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes stay within the month-wide actions and the new method. The let-to-const tidy in setNMonthAvg is incidental, and the tests cover only the #fixed rule.

maintainability.why: A future change to which categories are filled or how the sign is chosen is made once. The requireGroup option keeps the averages' old no-group exclusion explicit, though a maintainer may not see why it exists.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the 3/6/12-month averages all decide through shouldFillCategory; setNMonthAvg and the averages share averageToBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repeat is the notes LEFT JOIN in two category queries that load differently shaped rows; it is visible, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory takes requireGroup (keeps the averages' old group-join inconsistency) and includeHiddenCategories (the requested option); the requireGroup check is its one special-case branch. Every action uses the helper.
